reviews.reviewText: Impressed by the Chanderi Kurti set! The Lucknowi embroidery is fine and neat without loose threads. Pure cotton lining makes it extremely comfortable for all-day festive events.
The Nehru jacket fit is tailored to perfection. Pure linen texture gives a very premium royal look with white kurta. The brass buttons add great vintage flair.
Superb packaging with tissue butter paper and customized brand garment bag. Felt like unboxing a luxury designer boutique order!

reviews.productName: Festive Gold Tissue Anarkali Gown with Dupatta
reviews.reviewText: Anarkali gown flare is massive (almost 4.5 meters)! The gota patti work shimmers beautifully in evening lighting. Sleeves fitting was just slightly snug but easily alterable.

reviews.productName: Banarasi Pure Katan Silk Zari Saree
reviews.reviewText: Authentic Kolhapuri craftsmanship! Pure leather smells genuine and cushioned insole prevented any shoe bite even after 6 hours on feet.
Color shown on website matched 100% with the real saree in natural sunlight. Prompt BlueDart delivery within 48 hours to Delhi NCR.
Fabric quality and stitching finish are top tier. Sizing chart is very accurate. Will definitely recommend to friends and family.
Very elegant design and rich color saturation. Looks twice as expensive as its price tag. Great Indian artisan craftsmanship.

reviews.productName: Festive Gold Tissue Anarkali Gown with Dupatta
reviews.reviewText: Loved the soft fall of the silk! It's so pliable and easy to pleat compared to synthetic blends. Totally worth every rupee.

reviews.productName: Banarasi Pure Katan Silk Zari Saree
reviews.reviewText: Dress fabric and design are gorgeous, but delivery courier took 2 extra days due to festive backlog. Customer support on WhatsApp was prompt though.
Kurta set fabric did not shrink or bleed color after the first cold wash. Extremely satisfied with dye fastness.
Very comfortable fit around shoulders and chest. Nehru jacket pockets are functional and well-constructed.
Everything about this boutique experience was stellar - from easy UPI checkout to pristine unboxing. 5 stars!
